# Rigged human asset

Author: Quaternius. Pack: Universal Base Characters, Standard/free release.
Publisher and license: https://quaternius.com/packs/universalbasecharacters.html
Official distribution: https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-base-characters
Both publisher pages identify the pack as CC0 1.0; original `LICENSE.txt` retained.
The asset is a stylized humanoid, not a scanned person or validated biomechanics
model. No paid pack, Mixamo asset, account, API key or external application code.

Retrieved 2026-10-23 as a compact GLB redistribution, **not directly from the
publisher ZIP**. Provenance documentation:
https://github.com/programasweights/avatar/blob/5df3cb35c8c93e59a3c545e2ca1edd13b77e4240/ASSETS.md

That distributor identifies source
`Base Characters/Godot - UE/Superhero_Male_FullBody.gltf`, preserves skin weights,
geometry and skeleton, replaces materials with matte jade and removes textures.
Its reported original Standard ZIP hash is
`fdbf1804c90dfc1ea03e992bff7da2dfd1a79318e13270a660180f9308455f40`;
we did not download that full ZIP and do not claim independent ZIP verification.

Pinned download base:
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/programasweights/avatar/5df3cb35c8c93e59a3c545e2ca1edd13b77e4240/public/assets/`

| character.glb | character.glb | 741320 | d6f3b64cab629f6ddca9ba063811aeffd3663a8a4e49ade47cd9505dc2bbd70f |
| LICENSE.txt | QUATERNIUS-LICENSE.txt | 806 | 0f4beaf0fe360a7732e58bbe3dbf60a2422367fbea60cb9ea4add968f383268e |

The binary is kept unchanged. GLB metadata also identifies Quaternius/CC0.
Inspection found 65 skin joints, three meshes, no external buffers or images.
Local renderer applies gym colours and illustrative procedural motion at runtime.
These render changes are not model features, measured pose or sensor motion.
All browser assets are served locally; no CDN/publisher call occurs at runtime.
